sections.title: Built *on trust*

image.alt: Noah Zook holding a roll of plans outside a lake home

body: Noah Zook brings decades of experience and a dedication to quality instilled from a young age by his grandfather. He handles every project with care, uses the highest-quality materials, and loves watching clients’ faces light up as they walk through their finished home.
Designer Maria Huynh Rhinehart blends interior and architectural design, working closely with each client so the home reflects their style and needs.

items.text: We chose Noah for his experience with lakefront properties and his reputation for quality building. His meticulous attention to detail from the foundation to the finishing touches was impressive.
